title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: Analista Comunicação Junior
description:
ANALISTA COMUNICACAO JR


Sobre a GRU Airport


A GRU Airport, conhecido como o maior aeroporto do Brasil, conecta sonhos, destinos e oportunidades há quase quatro décadas.

Reconhecido como o principal hub da América Latina, a GRU Airport , administradora do Aeroporto Internacional de São Paulo, em Guarulhos, é referência em eficiência e conectividade. Porta de entrada do Brasil para o mundo.


Nossa infraestrutura e nossos serviços garantem uma operação contínua, segura e de qualidade, atendendo às necessidades de passageiros e empresas. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza a inovação, o desenvolvimento e o impacto positivo na jornada de cada viajante, venha construir o futuro conosco no setor da aviação.


Na GRU, acreditamos que cada colaborador é fundamental para alcançar novos patamares.


DESCRIÇÃO:


  • Colaborar com o desenvolvimento de conteúdo dos canais de Comunicação da empresa e gestão dos canais de comunicação que envolvem a exposição da marca (Intranet, site, aplicativo, eventos externos institucionais e/ou com empresas e órgãos que atuam no aeroporto).
  • Suporte na gestão da aplicação da marca em conteúdo como revistas, redes sociais, peças publicitárias e comunicados.
  • Alinhamento com os stakeholders internos (Comercial; TECA; Operações; Responsabilidade Social, entre outros) para desenvolver estratégia de comunicação em consonância com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, seja em canais digitais, seja para geração de conteúdo para imprensa.
  • Suporte de rotinas administrativas e financeiras da área.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:


1. Elaborar/ revisar os procedimentos de comunicação delimitando responsabilidades e prazos, e comunicar aos stakeholders internos.

2. Dar suporte ao planejamento orçamentário da área quando necessário;

3. Realizar medição dos contratos quando necessário;

4. Dar suporte na rotina de briefing e acompanhamento das atividades das agências prestadoras de serviço (produção de campanhas, desenvolvimento de materiais relacionados às campanhas, etc.);

5. Desenvolver o processo de produção de materiais gráficos do GRU, em interface com a agência prestadora de serviço e áreas internas envolvidas, prezando pelo bom funcionamento do processo, pelo uso adequado dos recursos;

6. Administrar a organização e/ou participar de eventos de GRU ou nos quais GRU esteja presente, como feiras do segmento, atividades com parceiros, entre outros, garantindo o bom andamento da execução dos processos, como o credenciamento, por exemplo, além de um bom aproveitamento das oportunidades de marketing de experiência junto ao público ao qual se destinam. 7. Manter atualizado a rede de contatos com os responsáveis pela área de comunicação dos parceiros comerciais do GRU Airport (cias aéreas; lojistas; outros);

8. Prestar esclarecimentos e suporte às demais áreas envolvidas nos processos e projetos de comunicação, prestando apoio técnico nos assuntos relacionados à sua área de atuação.

9. Fortalecer estratégias de melhoria da experiência do cliente no aeroporto, por meio de atualizações constantes dos conteúdos dos canais de comunicações já existentes, assim como propondo soluções que corroboram para o encantamento do cliente.

10. Responsável pela gestão da marca nos canais proprietários do aeroporto, acompanhando constantemente a percepção dos clientes com relação ao GRU. E, dessa forma, preservar a imagem do aeroporto.

11. Elaborar e editar conteúdos para os diversos canais de comunicação de interna e externa, de acordo com as características do público-alvo, além suportar as agências de Assessoria de Imprensa e digital na revisão de conteúdo de pautas relacionadas ao negócio.

12. Identificar oportunidades de promoção da imagem do aeroporto alinhadas à estratégia de posicionamento da marca e negócio.

13. Contribuir com a elaboração do manual e comunicação do GRU Airport, incluindo situações de crise, definindo nomenclaturas, porta voz, palavras chaves, definição de estilo de linguagem para cada processo canal de comunicação.


REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS


Vivência na área.

Superior Completo em Comunicação, Administração, Marketing, Publicidade

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita


CONHECIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS / HABILIDADES


Conhecimento em Assessoria de Imprensa

Conhecimento em ferramentas digitais

Conhecimento em estratégias mídias sociais

Conhecimento de marketing com foco em gestão de marca

Desejável conhecimento no setor aeroportuário

Habilidade de relacionamento com as empresas do setor

Habilidade em gerenciamento de crises em todas as mídias

Habilidade de comunicação no idioma inglês

Habilidade de relacionamento com esferas do poder público


PACOTE ATRATIVOS


⏰ Horário Comercial - 08:30 -17:30 - 40 horas semanais

Salário Compatível com o Mercado

️ Vale Refeição: R$ 1255,78 mês;

title: LHP_Senior KDB/Q Developer_Remote Mexico dup
description:
Project Description:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.
  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes

Então, olhe só a oportunidade que temos para você:

  • Trabalhar com planilha dinâmica e funções do Excel de modo avançado e elaboração de apresentações no Powerpoint;
  • Atuar com softwares de pesquisa de mídia como Instar, Monitor, AdInsights, TGI entre outros;

  • Conhecimento em Excel e Power Point (avançados);

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Levantar dados de campo junto às unidades de negócio (bombas, motores, pressões, vazões, faturas e medições elétricas) e construir baseline energético.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos (ponto de operação vs. BEP, setpoints, perfil de carga, demanda, fator de potência e harmônicos).

Na LatamReady, somos a referência na implementação de Oracle NetSuite para empresas em expansão em toda a América Latina. Não apenas implementamos software; transformamos negócios e os ajudamos a escalar. Para continuar esta missão, buscamos incorporar ao nosso time Consultores(as) ERP Sênior de alto calibre.


Sua Missão como Consultor(a) ERP Sênior:


Você será peça-chave na otimização dos processos de negócio de nossos clientes através da implementação e consultoria especializada em soluções ERP. Seu conhecimento em sistemas como SAP (Business One, S/4HANA), Microsoft Dynamics (AX, NAV, 365), Oracle (EBS, JD Edwards) ou, idealmente, Oracle NetSuite, será fundamental para desenhar e implementar soluções que gerem impacto real.


O Que Esperamos de Você?


  • Domínio Comprovado em ERPs (+5 anos Implementando ERPs): Precisamos da sua experiência tangível no ciclo completo de projetos ERP: desde a análise de necessidades, design da solução, configuração, até a implantação e o suporte pós-implementação. Não basta conhecer a teoria; buscamos resultados comprovados.
  • Visão de Negócio: Você entenderá os desafios e objetivos de negócio dos nossos clientes para traduzir suas necessidades em soluções ERP funcionais e eficientes que agreguem valor quantificável.
  • Capacidade de Execução: Liderará e executará projetos de implementação, assegurando a qualidade, o cumprimento de prazos e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Comunicação Direta e Eficaz: Você se comunicará com clareza e precisão tanto com as equipes técnicas quanto com os níveis diretivos dos nossos clientes.
  • Inglês Avançado Indispensável: A interação com equipes e documentação internacional é constante. Um nível de inglês avançado, tanto oral quanto escrito, é um fator determinante para o sucesso nesta posição.


O Que Você Terá ao se Juntar à LatamReady?


  • A oportunidade de trabalhar com empresas líderes e em crescimento em toda a região.
  • Projetos desafiadores que permitirão aplicar sua expertise e gerar um impacto real.
  • Ser parte de uma organização focada na excelência, com um profundo conhecimento de Oracle NetSuite e do mercado latino-americano.
  • Um ambiente onde sua contribuição direta para o sucesso de nossos clientes é o principal indicador de seu desempenho.
  • Compensação competitiva e desenvolvimento profissional na principal solução Cloud ERP do mundo.


Se você é um(a) Consultor(a) ERP com profundo conhecimento em sistemas ERP, clara orientação a resultados, domina o inglês em nível avançado e está pronto(a) para levar sua carreira ao próximo nível em um ambiente dinâmico e focado, esta é sua oportunidade!


Próximos Passos:

Candidate-se aqui! Estamos buscando os melhores. Mostre-nos que é você.

title: Senior Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Senior Cloud Solution Architect- Automation

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long-term contract


In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.
  • Soft Skills and Others:
  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Consultant OKTA
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Required

• Experience in Okta administration and configuration or in other identity tools

• Full stack development experience (e.g. React or some other front-end framework, APIs, GraphQL and backends such as NodeJS, Drupal, etc)

• Experience writing JavaScript or Python code

• Experience working in agile teams (Scrum Preferred, Kanban sufficient)


Preferred

• Okta Professional certification or Okta Developer certification

• Hands on experience with Auth0

• Dev-ops experience with Jenkins, CI/CD and Terraform

• Experience working with Jira

• Experience with XENA or willing to learn our J&J processes


Bonus

• AWS experience (S3 setup and management)


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.
  • Soft Skills and Others:
  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Especialista em Parcerias Estratégicas
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Especialista em Parcerias para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, mapear e prospectar organizações estratégicas (empresas de grande porte, associações e sindicatos).
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias comerciais com potencial de gerar grande volume de usuários ou receita recorrente.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com BPOs que atendem empresas de grande porte para viabilizar contratos de alto impacto.
  • Representar a Jusfy em eventos estratégicos do setor jurídico, contábil e corporativo.
  • Acompanhar performance das parcerias e propor planos de expansão.


Experiência

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas, negócios corporativos ou vendas complexas (preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia).
  • Vivência em ambiente de crescimento e ritmo acelerado.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais a clientes/parceiros.


Diferencial

  • Experiência ou conhecimentos sobre o mercado jurídico.


Habilidades

  • Capacidade de negociação em alto nível e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de representação em eventos externos.


Ferramentas e dados

  • Experiência com CRM (preferencialmente Hubspot)


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, ownership e foco em solução de problemas
  • Curiosidade e sede por aprendizado contínuo
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados e crescimento


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Partnership Specialist e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga.

title: Analista de Suporte - Protheus
description:
Descrição da vaga

O principal objetivo dessa posição é apoiar os clientes em projetos que vão desde a implementação e otimização dos módulos do sistema Protheus, garantindo que as soluções entregues não apenas atendam, mas superem as expectativas de negócio.

Nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na entrega de valor e na satisfação do cliente. Você será responsável por entender profundamente os processos de negócio, mapear os requisitos e configurar os módulos do Protheus de acordo com o escopo de cada projeto.

Um diferencial, conhecimento no Configurador de Tributos do módulo Fiscal do Protheus, para apoio aos clientes na Reforma Tributária.




Responsabilidades e atribuições

● Projetos de Implantação: Configuração e o setup dos módulos, desde o levantamento inicial até a homologação final, garantindo que a transição seja suave e eficiente para o cliente.

● Melhoria Contínua: Implementar módulos e rotinas já em uso, como a criação/escopo de rotin

aspersonalizadas ou a automação de processos, visando aumentar a produtividade e reduzir gargalos.

● Atuação Estratégica: Participar de reuniões com clientes e parceiros para entender as demandas, desenhar soluções técnicas e apresentar propostas, demonstrando seu conhecimento técnico e sua capacidade de influenciar positivamente o resultado.

● O grande desafio será traduzir a complexidade de negócios em configurações e funcionalidades no Protheus, atuando em diferentes segmentos de mercado e se adaptando rapidamente a novas realidades. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem uma ótima comunicação e adora resolver problemas, esta é a oportunidade perfeita para você crescer e deixar sua marca em projetos de grande impacto.

● Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: O Analista Sênior é um pilar de conhecimento para a equipe. Inclua a responsabilidade de orientar e capacitar analistas de níveis júnior e pleno. Ele(a) deve ser a referência técnica para questões complexas e um mentor(a) para o desenvolvimento da equipe.

● Gestão de Projetos e Escopo Complexo: Além de participar, o sênior apoia a gerência de projetos de grande escala e alta complexidade. Isso envolve participar do planejamento, da definição de escopo e a gestão de riscos, garantindo que os projetos sejam entregues no prazo e dentro do orçamento.

● Resolução de Problemas Críticos e Tomada de Decisão: A capacidade de resolver problemas é levada a um novo patamar. O sênior é o(a) responsável por solucionar os desafios mais difíceis e críticos que a equipe não consegue resolver. A vaga deve destacar a habilidade de tomar decisões sob pressão, com base em sua vasta experiência.


Requisitos e qualificações

● Formação superior em: Superior completo na área de TI ( Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação) Gestão de Projetos, Administração de Sistemas e áreas relacionadas a Tecnologia.

● Vivência em Projetos com o Protheus - técnicos.

● Conhecimento em Protheus



Requisitos desejáveis

Um diferencial, conhecimento no Configurador de Tributos do módulo Fiscal do Protheus, para apoio aos clientes na Reforma Tributária. Certificações relacionadas a projetos, Protheus e atendimento ao cliente.


Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.



Sobre a empresa

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.

● Gestão de Projetos e Escopo Complexo: Além de participar, o sênior apoia a gerência de projetos de grande escala e alta complexidade. Isso envolve participar do planejamento, da definição de escopo e a gestão de riscos, garantindo que os projetos sejam entregues no prazo e dentro do orçamento.

● Resolução de Problemas Críticos e Tomada de Decisão: A capacidade de resolver problemas é levada a um novo patamar. O sênior é o(a) responsável por solucionar os desafios mais difíceis e críticos que a equipe não consegue resolver. A vaga deve destacar a habilidade de tomar decisões sob pressão, com base em sua vasta experiência.


Requisitos e qualificações

● Formação superior em: Superior completo na área de TI ( Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação) Gestão de Projetos, Administração de Sistemas e áreas relacionadas a Tecnologia.

● Vivência em Projetos com o Protheus - técnicos.

● Conhecimento em Protheus



Requisitos desejáveis

Um diferencial, conhecimento no Configurador de Tributos do módulo Fiscal do Protheus, para apoio aos clientes na Reforma Tributária. Certificações relacionadas a projetos, Protheus e atendimento ao cliente.


Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;

  • Gympass.



Sobre a empresa

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.

description:
#VAGA para Analista Senior de Sistemas PeopleSoft – Financials (AR/AP)

Remoto LATAM – Contractor (PJ) via Deel


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de Sistemas PeopleSoft sênior para atuar em projeto global de sistemas financeiros, contratado via Stefanini LATAM por meio da plataforma Deel (modelo PJ / contractor).

O trabalho é remoto, com base em LATAM, apoiando a área de Corporate Finance Technology de um grande cliente internacional. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui forte domínio técnico em PeopleSoft Financials (contas a receber e a pagar), extensões e integrações customizadas, e está habituado(a) a atuar em ambiente offshore/near-shore.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e executar o design técnico, desenvolvimento e manutenção dos módulos PeopleSoft Financials — especificamente Accounts Receivable (AR) e Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Criar, aprimorar e dar suporte a extensões, customizações e integrações em PeopleSoft utilizando PeopleTools, PeopleCode, Component Interface, Application Engine, SQR, Integration Broker
  • Colaborar com equipes de finanças e tecnologia globalmente para dar suporte aos processos de negócios financeiros, garantir integridade de dados, performance e alinhamento às necessidades do negócio
  • Diagnosticar, otimizar e dar suporte ao ambiente PeopleSoft ao longo do ciclo de vida do sistema
  • Produzir documentação técnica, participar de code reviews e garantir a aplicação de boas práticas e padrões


Requisitos

  • Experiência prática a nível sênior com PeopleSoft Financials (módulos AR/AP)
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e manutenção de extensões/customizações e integrações no PeopleSoft
  • Elevado nível técnico: PeopleTools, PeopleCode, Application Designer, Component Interface, Integration Broker, SQR, App Engine
  • Boa compreensão dos processos financeiros (AR, AP, fluxo de razão geral)
  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado) – capacidade de trabalhar com equipes baseadas nos EUA e globalmente


VENHA SER STEFANINER!

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.
